policy.derivation: gross vertical height - each required deduction, each with its own source authority; one unknown required component -> BLOCKED at rank 3 (never filled by a default)
policy.scope: project + revision + floor / zone + trade (+ space classes)
never: floor-to-floor alone as a wall height
an owner rationale as a formula
one trade's height clipped to another's
a height transferred to another floor, revision or project

method.principle: WALL FINISH HEIGHT IS NOT A COMPANY-WIDE NUMBER: it is established per floor / measurement scope and per trade
hierarchy: derived clear height from authoritative vertical components

never: a wall height from floor-to-floor alone
a derivation with an unknown component

no_company_constant: no URBAN_DEFAULT_WALL_HEIGHT (or equivalent) exists in engine/ or the rule store
future_derivation: gross vertical height from source levels (finished-floor to finished-floor, or slab to slab with the build-up as a component) MINUS each established deduction (beam / soffit zone where the finish stops at it, ceiling / service / decor zone, floor build-up when the gross is slab-based) - each component carrying its own source and authority; the result carries formula, components, state. Floor-to-floor alone is never a wall height.
